description.p: Rongyok Desk is a single-site browser. Instead of a browser full of tabs, it gives you one window for one website, so rongyok.com feels like an app rather than a page.

It opens the site directly, keeps you signed in between launches, and reopens the window at the size and place you left it. Links to anywhere else open in your normal browser, so the window stays on the one site.
Added in-app Check for Updates modal, strict release URL verification, and signed updater support.
Added Keyboard Shortcuts onboarding modal and About Rongyok Desk dialog.
Updated macOS and GNOME 49 Flatpak release packaging.
Initial release of Rongyok Desk for rongyok.com.
